title: ‘God Loves You and Is With You in That Car Right Now’
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III reminds those sleeping in their cars tonight that God is with them and Jesus Christ will never leave them.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“God loves you and is with you in that car right now. Jesus Christ loves you and He will never leave you nor forsake you.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.” (Hebrews 13:5, KJV)
